solves.reasoning: (A) voice should resonate with readers, not clash. (B) brand should be memorable, not forgettable. (C) should be distinct from competitors, not similar.
(A) pinpointing = precisely identifying target audience. (B) scholars initially find concepts alien (strange). (C) developing innovative ideas, not common ones.
(A) aim is to highlight gaps, not obscure them. (B) overlooked areas need addressing, not celebrated ones. (C) cultivating a distinctive voice to stand out.
conceal(숨기다) contradicts the purpose of literature review which is to highlight gaps. Original word: highlight.
identical(동일한) contradicts the goal of being distinct from competitors. Original word: distinct.
abandoning(포기하다) contradicts the idea of balancing expression with voice development. Original word: balancing.
building a ___ that makes them memorable and distinct = brand. Budget/schedule/audience don't fit the context of creating memorable identity.
highlight ___ in existing research → gaps. Research gaps are what scholars identify to position their work. Strengths/profits/achievements would weaken the argument.
not just developing ideas but ___ a distinctive voice → cultivating. Suppressing/imitating/abandoning all contradict developing a unique voice.
resonates with readers = connects with readers. Fades/conflicts/disappears are opposite or unrelated.
pinpointing = precisely identifying. Overlooking/dismissing/broadening don't mean precise identification.
alien in context = unfamiliar/strange. Not familiar(opposite), essential, or appealing.
distinct(구별되는) ↔ indistinguishable(구별 불가). Unique/prominent/remarkable are similar, not opposite.
overlooked(간과된) ↔ scrutinized(면밀히 조사된). Neglected/abandoned/forgotten are similar to overlooked.
(A) drawing customers = attracting/끌어들이다. (B) drawing sunset with pencils = sketching/그리다.
a statement proposing value or benefit = proposition. Competition/impression/expression don't match the definition.
a ___(recognize) identity — needs adjective to modify noun. recognize → recognizable.
the ___(express) of your ideas — needs noun after 'the' before 'of'. express → expression.
scholars engage in similar practices in their academic writing. Products/services and business world relate to entrepreneurs, not scholars.
pinpointing audience + crafting ___ + shaping identity → a unique value proposition. This is the core entrepreneurial strategy triad.
